ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Write down where you want to be a year from now.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: End the day with a minute of gratitude for what has changed in you.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to your partner or to a close friend.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Swap a snack for fruit and notice how you feel.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Dance at home, even if it is just to one song.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Open the windows in the morning and let fresh air into your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Before reacting to a message, read it twice.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Think of a way to make one of your talents pay off.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Start something new today, however small.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Spend five minutes in silence before going to sleep.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Write down a dream and three steps to get there.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Set aside an hour without interruptions for what matters most.
